fail.quote: For early-warning usefulness, measure how far before the churn outcome flagged customers were identified at the approved operating point... Report the lead-time distribution and review volume... Predeclare any supplementary paired customer-level bootstrap sensitivity analysis
fail.reason: The task already has an explicit judge, holdout validation, an independent audit and fixed methods, and the owner asked to keep them unchanged. The response neither returns it unchanged with a reason nor repairs a concrete remaining defect. It adds new analyses (lead-time and review-volume diagnostics, a bootstrap sensitivity analysis, negative-control falsification) and an extended checklist. These are the 'another experiment' additions the case forbids as manufactured contributions.
